scenarios.reason: 6 activity cards present in #activity-list; each card contains trade, activity name, zone in .card-meta, and a .badge element with status text

A1's proposedPct is 100 instead of 80. extractPercentage tests /\bdone\b/ before the numeric '80 percent' pattern; since the message ends with 'done', the done-branch fires and returns 100. The numeric extraction branch is never reached. A2=10, A3=50, A5=100 are correct.
A4 and A6 have status-gap class; A1, A2, A3, A5 have status-pending; no gap card appears for mapped activities
approveActivity sets status to approved and rerenders; resulting card has status-approved class and contains no .btn-approve element

mapMessageToActivity uses tokenized alias arrays with zone (+5), trade (+4), foremanId (+3) scoring. 'north' matches A1 zoneAliases, 'mep' matches A3 tradeAliases, 'pour'+'zone'+'1' match A5. All 3 test inputs resolve to correct activities via alias matching, not exact field names.

Red left border + red badge for gap, amber border + amber badge + prominent green Approve and blue Override buttons for pending, green border + green badge for approved. States are distinguishable by color alone; pending items have clear CTAs that draw the eye.

runs.spec_amendment: In extractPercentage, the explicit numeric patterns ('80%', '80 percent', word-form numbers) must be evaluated BEFORE the keyword patterns ('done', 'complete', 'finished', 'almost done', etc.). If a numeric percentage signal is present in the text, it takes precedence over any keyword signal. Reorder the checks: parse numeric % first, then word-form numbers, then keywords as fallback.

scenarios.reason: All 6 activity cards render in #activity-list; each card contains card-name, card-meta with trade and zone, and a status badge element

A1 maps to 80% (numeric '80 percent' pattern), A2 maps to 10% ('just started'), A3 maps to 50% ('halfway'), A5 maps to 100% ('finished' keyword). All four have status-pending class and display an Approve button with correct proposed percentages
A4 and A6 retain status-gap class with red left border and 'No update' badge; A1/A2/A3/A5 have status-pending class — no status-gap present on those cards
approveActivity sets status to 'approved' and re-renders; post-click A1 card receives status-approved class and the approve button is absent from the re-rendered card

mapMessageToActivity tokenizes aliases and scores matches: 'north' token matches A1 zoneAliases (+5), 'mep' token matches A3 tradeAliases (+4), 'zone'+'1' tokens match A5 zoneAliases (+5). All 3 test inputs resolve to correct activities via alias array matching without exact field name lookup

Three states are visually distinct by color alone: red left border + red badge for gap, amber border + amber badge + green Approve and blue Override buttons for pending, green border + green badge for approved. Pending and gap states are more visually prominent than approved; no legend required to interpret the states
